inputs.first_frame:
High-quality 2D anime cinematic style, Cardcaptor Sakura transformation
sequence compilation: cel-animated look with premium sakuga polish, glowing
pastel palette, sakura petals and star particles in the air, sparkling magic
circles, anamorphic lens feel, shallow depth of field, film grain, volumetric
light rays, restrained grading for a premium feel, powerful dynamic motion.

Scene overview: a rapid-fire montage of the protagonist's transformation
forms, each transformation bursting from a magic circle — classic yellow
Clow-style circle, pink Star Wand circle, and the crystal-blue Clear Card
circle — every switch landing hard on the musical beat, escalating to an
ecstatic finale.

Storyboard (each shot a separate scene, rapid cuts, all landing on the
musical beats):
[0s-1.5s] Shot 1: a magic circle ignites beneath her feet on the dark
ground, glowing runes spiraling outward, slow-motion start.
[1.5s-3s] Shot 2: transformation begins — a pink light cocoon wraps her,
feathery wings burst open behind her, costume materializing in ribbons of
light.
[3s-4.5s] Shot 3: she spins and raises her wand, a tarot-like card spinning
on her fingertip, star sparkles exploding at the beat.
[4.5s-6s] Shot 4: Star Wand held high overhead, a starburst of gold and
pink light erupts, the wand tip blooming into the star form.
[6s-7.5s] Shot 5: moonlit variant — silver-blue glow, crescent moon motif,
her silhouette framed against a giant lunar circle.
[7.5s-9s] Shot 6: Clear Card form — crystalline, diamond-transparent light,
shards of prismatic glass swirling around her.
[9s-10.5s] Shot 7: rapid-cut montage — three transformation silhouettes
flipping in and out of their magic circles on consecutive beats.
[10.5s-12s] Shot 8: all magic circles overlap in a spiral vortex, flying
cards orbiting her like a galaxy ring.
[12s-15s] Shot 9: finale freeze — she stands at the center of a giant
resplendent magic circle, cards forming a halo ring around her, golden
light bursting outward as the score climaxes.

Camera: each shot its own angle, cuts clean and hard, no dissolves, a slight
frame kick on every transformation beat.

Audio: soaring orchestral score with electronic bass drops, sparkling
chime effects, an accent hit on every transformation, the score bursting at
12s, closing the last 1s.

Anime style 2D cel shading, no text, subtitles, logos or watermarks, no 3D
render look, keep the hand-drawn anime texture and vibrant magic-girl glow.
